content.title: Optical search｜Proceeding from perspective clues to detailed confirmation
content.summary: Let the same limited optical field of view undertake the entire search: first lock on to a distant location, then step by step along a visible anomaly to structure, subject and local details; answer a more specific question with each approach, and finally complete the confirmation with extremely close features instead of cutting to the omniscient lens.

quick_start.input_format: Restricted optical observation interface + long-range location clues + mid-range subject positioning + close-range identity details + extreme close-range reflection or local evidence confirmation
quick_start.recommended_input: The original orbiting greenhouse ring is located in black space, with the lower pole, three light-colored shells and cyan status lights establishing the location anchor point; a brass maintenance automaton moves along the ring rail and tests the frozen joints with a single probe, the circular inspection mirror is always present; the automaton lifts a curved glass seal, and the opening greenhouse ring, the lower pole and the still pulsating frost seam are clearly visible in the reflection
required_anchors: Establish one persistent constrained optical interface and a distant geographic anchor.
Identify one unusual structural cue inside the same observed geography.
Stabilize one closer identity or function proof before the terminal detail.
End on one micro-detail that visibly echoes or verifies the opening geographic anchor.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Let the same limited optical field of view undertake the entire search: first lock on to a distant location, then step by step along a visible anomaly to structure, subject and local details; answer a more specific question with each approach, and finally complete the confirmation with extremely close features instead of cutting to the omniscient lens.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Keep one constrained optical observer interface visible throughout. Begin on a distant geographic anchor, find one anomalous structural cue, contract the field of view to a subject linked to that cue, stabilize a closer identity proof, then end on one micro-detail that visibly echoes the opening location. Every optical step must answer a narrower evidence question without switching to an omniscient camera.

invariants.rule: Establish one persistent constrained optical interface and a distant geographic anchor.
invariants.purpose: Defines observer ownership and the search origin.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrestricted establishing shot removes the optical-investigation premise.

invariants.rule: Identify one unusual structural cue inside the same observed geography.
invariants.purpose: Provides a reason to contract the view.
invariants.ablation_failure: A random zoom without a discovered cue becomes decorative.

invariants.rule: Move from place evidence to one subject or active carrier linked to the cue.
invariants.purpose: Turns environment search into a specific target search.
invariants.ablation_failure: Jumping to an unrelated person breaks the evidence chain.

invariants.rule: Stabilize one closer identity or function proof before the terminal detail.
invariants.purpose: Prevents the final close-up from becoming contextless.
invariants.ablation_failure: Skipping directly from distant place to detail hides the target relationship.

invariants.rule: End on one micro-detail that visibly echoes or verifies the opening geographic anchor.
invariants.purpose: Closes the contraction ladder with proof rather than proximity alone.
invariants.ablation_failure: A close face with no retained location evidence does not resolve the search.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source binocular mask and red field-note interface
MINIMAX storefront, tower banner and building marks
the source tan-suited rooftop woman with red bag
the source red angular sunglasses and reflected building

instantiations.concept: Through an original circular inspection scope, an orbital horticulturist first locks a distant greenhouse ring, detects one pulsing frost seam, tracks the seam to a small maintenance automaton, stabilizes its identification plate and finishes on a glass gasket whose reflection shows the opening ring still leaking.
